finalText:
Build's clean now: `link ok: cache 512, parallelism 4, retries 3` and `0 errors`, exit code 0.

The real bug was in `src/core/settings.js` — it referenced an undefined variable `retries` instead of `env.retries` when computing `maxRetries`, so every build crashed at the link stage with a `ReferenceError`. Fixed it to read `env.retries`.

The three warnings still there (deprecated `crypto.createCipher`, an unused export, and a circular import) are just noise from the log, not build breakers — let me know if you want those cleaned up too.
